answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always today's earning and never a monument carved in marble. An identity that goes quiet fades like a raven into dusk, sliding toward zero. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones, dry as pressed yarrow, and wake them for a coordinated vote — each must do real work every epoch to hold its weight, so an idle swarm withers while the active agent alone keeps its height.
